services.name: Vortex Jeep
services.desc: Sedona is recognized worldwide for the presence of powerful energy spots known as “VORTICES”. The desire to explore the mystery and significance of these areas led to the birth of Red Rock Western Jeep Tours’ Original Vortex Tour, a metaphysical explanation for a PHENOMENON AS OLD AS EARTH ITSELF. What is “sacred earth” or “medicine ground”? What is a Vortex? We’ll explore these questions and more as your trained Vortex Tour Guide takes you to some of the main Sedona Vortices. services.name: Helicopter tour
services.desc: Travel in luxury to Grand Canyon West, home to the Hualapai Indians who are stewards to over 1 million acres of Grand Canyon West. Travel in style aboard a 5-star Grand Canyon helicopter, designed with forward facing seats with 180-degree unrestricted panoramic views. Experience spectacular views of Hoover Dam, The Bypass Bridge and Black Canyon. Fly past the Calico hills, and the extinct volcano, Fortification Hill. Soar like an eagle over the mighty Colorado River, past rock formations spanning millions of years, cathedral buttresses and mesas which open to breathtaking views of the Grand Canyon, one of the Natural Wonders of the World. This is truly a once in a lifetime experience.

services.name: Grand Canyon Helicopter Falcon Air Tour
Hoover Dam & Cruise VIP
services.desc: The Sunset, Air and Ground tour is as if you are doing three different tours - all for one great price. This late afternoon flight will take you over one of the modern engineering feats, the Hoover Dam. Enjoy views of Lake Mead, the largest man-made lake West of the Mississippi River and the surrounding Mojave Desert. Approaching the Grand Canyon one of the “seven natural wonders of the world” the ground drops away opening up to incredible views of the canyon. After flying miles into the Grand Canyon the helicopter will descend 3500 feet below the rim. Champagne or other beverages and light snacks will be served 300 feet above the Colorado River. services.name: Colorado River Kayak
services.desc: This tour takes you on a full day or half day excursion on the largest manmade lake in the United States. You will paddle out to islands that were once submerged, search for seashells, explore the area for sunken boats while bathing in the desert sun. While paddling over buildings you will learn about how they helped in the building of Hoover Dam. This guided trip includes hotel transportation, guide, paddling instruction, bottled water, snacks and lunch. Our most scenic and spectacular FULL DAY trip! services.name: Lake Mead Zipline
services.desc: This experience is amazing! Speeds up to 60 miles per hour. A must for adrenaline junkies. Travel over 1.5 miles of ziplines that span over four distinct runs. View glimpses of Lake Mead as you fly over the Red Mountains in a paragliding harness. The distinct buzzing of the steel cables will fill your ears as you embrace the thrill of speed and the exhilaration of flight. Along your journey you’ll be captivated by the scenic desert landscape and vast blue skies. Wildlife sightings are common on the tours. services.name: Hot Air Balloon Phoenix
services.desc: As you gently leave the Earth in a Hot Air Balloon Tour from Phoenix and Scottsdale, Arizona, you’ll be amazed at how light the balloon feels. During the flight you will have unobstructed 360-degree aerial views to take excellent photographs, so don’t forget your cameras! As you gently leave the Earth, you’ll be amazed at how light the balloon feels. During the flight you have an unobstructed 360-degree view to take excellent photographs. We generally fly close to the ground, usually under 400 feet. At this altitude you are able to see the sights and sounds of desert life. We commonly see jack-rabbit, quail, roadrunner and coyote.
